Name: sales for the current month
Query:
Select a.DocNum, a.DocDate, a.CardCode, a.CardName, a.DocTotal from oinv a where a.CANCELED='N' and datepart(month, a.docdate)=MONTH(getdate())
	and DATEPART(YEAR, a.DocDate)=year(getdate())

Select b.ItemCode, c.ItemName, sum(b.Quantity) as SalesQuantity, sum(b.LineTotal) as SalesValue from oinv a join inv1 b on a.DocEntry=b.DocEntry  
	join OITM c on c.ItemCode=b.ItemCode
	where a.CANCELED='N' and datepart(month, a.docdate)=MONTH(getdate())
	and DATEPART(YEAR, a.DocDate)=year(getdate())
